# Ghost Continuum
> Open-source Living Digital Immune System - v3.5.0 Crystal Membrane. Command Nexus with command palette, time-window NL queries, keyboard cockpit, hover-expand fabric map, Ghost LAN tab, Home Shield, Merkle forensics. Defensive only. Local-first. Zero core npm deps.

Site: https://ghost.jonbailey.xyz/
Hub preview: https://ghost.jonbailey.xyz/hub/
Source: https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/ghost-continuum
License: MIT

## What it is

Ghost Continuum is an open-source polymorphic honeypot and defensive deception engine: traps evolve via NSGA-II, personas morph at runtime, and evidence is Merkle-sealed - for authorized targets on your own network only. Version 3.5.0 Crystal Membrane upgrades Command Nexus (Ctrl/Cmd+K palette, last-24h queries that actually filter time, keyboard views) and the public landing.

## Quick answers

- **Offensive?** No. Defensive only.
- **Cloud required?** No. Local-first. Optional Cloudflare edge for sites you already host.
- **Core dependencies?** Zero npm packages in the engine. Node.js 18+.
- **Latest version?** 3.5.0 Crystal Membrane - https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/ghost-continuum/releases/latest
- **Install:** git clone, npm run setup, npm start -> http://127.0.0.1:30000
- **Command Nexus 3.5:** Ctrl/Cmd+K palette, 1-5 views, / query, time-window + IP NL search
- **Home Shield:** wizard + kid mode + quiet hours for home / lab operators

- Public site: architecture planes, lifecycle demo, efficacy gauges, quickstart, FAQ
